title: Unbilled Supply Days in C&I Termination Security
content:
**Q. Under Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts, what rule governs exposure days in termination security?**

A. The termination security's exposure days are its unbilled supply days, counted from the day after the billing period end of the most recently posted cycle through the day before the termination effective date: more unbilled supply days than the structure's termination notice days are used as counted, no unbilled supply days at all give zero exposure days, and any other count gives the termination notice days.

| Structure | Termination notice days |
|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | 30 |

| Unbilled supply days | Exposure days |
|---|---|
| more than 30 | the unbilled supply days as counted |
| 1 to 30 | 30 |
| none | 0 |

## Questions answered

**Which cycle is the most recently posted?** The cycle of the supply line with the latest posted date; the count runs from the day after that cycle's billing period end.

**Which days are counted?** Every day from the day after that billing period end through the day before the termination effective date, both included. Billing period end 31 March 2026 and termination effective date 30 April 2026 give 1 April through 29 April: 29 unbilled supply days, so 30 exposure days.

**What if billing is well behind the termination?** Billing period end 31 January 2026 and termination effective date 6 April 2026 give 1 February through 5 April: 28 plus 31 plus 5, that is 64 unbilled supply days, more than 30, so 64 exposure days.

**What if the last posted cycle already reaches the termination?** When that cycle's billing period end falls on or after the day before the termination effective date, there is no unbilled supply day, and the exposure days are zero.
